Haven In The Ear

The v2 earbud seated in an ear at true scale. Orbit it, pull it apart, tap any part to see what it is and whether it's chosen yet, or step through how sound gets from the room to your eardrum. The ear is a real 3D scan from TU Berlin's HUTUBS database, and the earbud is the v2 ergonomic shell, seated where the fit simulation put it. The scan closes the ear canal at its entrance, so the canal shown beyond that point is illustrative.

Drag to orbit · scroll or pinch to zoom · right-drag to pan · tap a part

Parts

Case envelope 53.5 × 45.5 × 25.5 mm. Buds lie on their charging-pad side over spring pins; magnets pull them into place. Paul chose a larger case battery (about 3 full recharges), so the real case will grow a few mm.
